subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept changing omitted Unix process-tree cleanup from unconditional group kill to leader-checked group kill for this shared helper?
rationale: This is the right-looking bug fix, but it intentionally changes a shared process cleanup default with compatibility and availability consequences that maintainers should own.

options.title: Accept Current Guard
options.body: Merge the current helper-side leader check plus caller audit after exact-head checks remain green.

options.title: Require Live Managed-Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for one more launchd-managed macOS gateway run before accepting the shared cleanup default change.

options.title: Request A Different Cleanup Contract
options.body: Pause the PR and ask for an alternative design if maintainers want omitted `detached` to keep the old behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Guard
recommendation.body: Merge the current helper-side leader check plus caller audit after exact-head checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: They approved and merged the prior detached-option fix whose default behavior this PR narrows.
